verdict.rationale: Rootly documents Alert Deduplication. It collapses repeat events from the same monitor onto a single open alert using a stable identifier, so the responder sees a count climbing instead of being paged again. That covers the 'duplicate' half of the story. There is no evidence of grouping related but distinct alerts (for example, from different monitors or services) into one incident or one page; alert routing only directs alerts to teams and escalation policies. Missing for 10: grouping or correlation of related non-identical alerts into a single incident or page, and independent or hands-on corroboration of deduplication behavior.
